job.title: Assembly Worker
job.description:
Assembly Worker

Join a family-owned manufacturer producing high-quality aluminium and steel transport equipment. This hands-on role involves building tray bodies and components in a safe, team-focused environment with a strong focus on quality and continuous improvement.

Please Note: Only applicants with full Australian working rights will be considered for this role.
  
BENEFITS
  • Guaranteed full time hours on Casual pay rates $33.05ph+super
  • Opportunity to go permanent with client and grow career.
  • Supportive and long-standing management team.
  • Family friendly team with regular team BBQs
  • Hydration Stations and Summer work hour adjustments to beat the heat.
  • Prioritises an organised, safe and professional workshop.
  
TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Assemble aluminium and galvanised steel trays and accessories, including custom builds, following job cards, processes, and time targets.
  • Complete quality checks and paperwork to ensure all trays meet specifications and quality standards.
  • Build tray components ahead of schedule to keep production running smoothly.
  • Cut and prepare aluminium materials accurately to prevent production delays.
  • Keep the workshop clean, organised, and ready for client visits.
  • Follow all safety procedures, wear required PPE, and report hazards or incidents.
  • Work well with the team, follow instructions, act professionally, and support continuous improvement. 

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
  • Experience in aluminium fabrication, tray building, or similar assembly work (preferred).
  • Experience in the motor vehicle or automotive accessory industry (preferred).
  • Ability to read and interpret job cards, job sheets, and measurements.
  • Competent use and care of hand tools and power tools.
  • Good numeracy and literacy skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality workmanship.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

A family-owned and operated business for over 30 years, manufacturing top-quality aluminium and steel transport equipment backed by quality assurance system. They are driven by a commitment to exceptional customer service, continuous improvement, and innovative designs.

Hatrix Recruitment is a growing boutique agency specialising in industrial, trade and professional recruitment. Guided by our philosophy of Connect. Recruit. Belong., we create long-term partnerships that deliver great outcomes for our clients, candidates and team.
